name: Lim Wei Jie
bio:
Lim Wei Jie discovered his passion for motorsport almost by accident, stumbling upon a go-karting event during a school outing. The sheer energy and precision captivated him. While not a driver himself, Wei Jie found his calling in ensuring the team was fueled and focused. He began volunteering at local races, helping with logistics and eventually finding his niche in catering. 

Wei Jie joined Walkenhorst Motorsport after impressing the team's logistics manager with his meticulous planning and resourcefulness. He believes that a well-fed and hydrated team is a winning team, and he approaches his role with scientific precision. He meticulously plans menus to optimize energy levels and recovery, considering individual dietary needs and preferences. He's known for his ability to source the freshest ingredients, even in remote locations, and his insistence on maintaining the highest hygiene standards.

Wei Jie is more than just a catering manager; he's a vital part of the Walkenhorst family. His dedication to providing the team with the best possible sustenance allows them to perform at their peak, making him an invaluable asset to the team's success. He is a firm believer that the smallest details can make a big difference and his commitment to excellence sets him apart.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a side parting
physical.description: Lim is of average height, with a lean build honed from years of carrying supplies and a focused gaze.

quirks: Insists on using a spreadsheet to track every ingredient and meal
Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and dietary information
Has a habit of sampling every dish to ensure it meets his high standards
